output.title: AdditionalCertificateOutputFormats feature promoted to GA
output.content: The change promotes the `AdditionalCertificateOutputFormats` feature to GA, so additional formats are always enabled. The environment uses cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate manifests, but the summary does not show whether this feature gate or additional output formats are set. Check Deployment args and Certificate specs for the feature gate or `additionalOutputFormats`.
